For the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation side of Warehousing & Fulfillment, the binding duties are concrete — Worker-safety rules (robot/zone safety duties); Labor law (scheduling compliance); Customs (bonded warehouses) (inventory evidence). We design against them from the first sprint so the audit reads the system, not a binder.
Starting without a leap of faith

Agentic AI & Hyperautomation engagements in Warehousing & Fulfillment open smaller than you expect: one workflow (pick-path and slotting stale), two weeks, a signed baseline. Everything after that is scoped against the measured delta, never a wish list.
Start with the diagnostic, not the contract: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Warehousing & Fulfillment baselined in two weeks, and a scoped proposal only if the delta justifies it.
